text:
Alex P: Heads-up — ACMECloud EU launch blocked by PO provisioning mismatch. PO accepted by the market but fulfillment failed because billing entity VAT != vendor VAT and local signatory differs by country. Also noticed SKU alias routed to us-east instead of eu-west. Need quick sync before the joint announcement.

Maya S: which PO? can we do a manual mapping to unblock? :grimacing:

Alex P: PO# 2026-ACME-4312. marketplace-bot shows accepted but fulfillment API returned 409 conflict: "billing_entity_mismatch". snippet: ```{"po":"2026-ACME-4312","vendor_vat":"FR12345","billing_vat":"DE67890","assigned_region":"eu-west-1","fulfilled_region":"us-east-1"}```

Fred L: tagging Legal — we can’t finalize revenue for EU if VAT and signatory don’t match. Marketplace requires local signatory for FR/DE unless we have delegation docs.

Sophie O: Ops found old alias mapping: ACME sku "ACME-EBS-XL" -> alias "ebs-xlarge-us" that routes to us-east. We can override alias temporarily, but partner sync may revert it unless we update canonical mapping upstream.

Giorgio F: Finance: VAT alignment needed before invoicing. We could accept PO and delay billing, but marketplace terms may not allow a delayed invoice. Risks of rejecting PO?

Maya S: Buyer says they need deployment live before quarter-end and we promised a press sync next week. We can’t delay announcement but can’t bypass VAT controls.

Fred L: Short-term proposal: 1) Ops does manual alias override to eu-west, 2) Legal provides temporary signatory delegation acceptable to the marketplace, 3) Finance flags invoice as provisional/holdback for VAT reconciliation. Everything contingent on marketplace’s acceptance of delegation.

marketplace-bot: automated update — Vendor mapping sync scheduled at 2026-04-03T03:00Z. Manual changes will be reconciled then.

Sophie O: I can apply manual override now but need marketplace API token with mapping:write scope. @Maya S can you request partner PM to allow a 48h override?

Maya S: pinged partner PM (cc @acmepm). They replied: "we can allow a manual alias for 48h if you submit a signed delegation PDF and a short SOW note." Sending now.

Giorgio F: If Legal produces delegation today, Finance can mark invoice provisional and hold VAT until reconciliation. Need exact legal wording for holdback line.

Fred L: Drafting delegation text and upload note. Proposed statement: "Redwood Inference accepts temporary signatory delegation for PO# 2026-ACME-4312 limited to provisioning actions only; full invoicing and entity transfer contingent on VAT reconciliation."

Alex P: Plan: Sophie overrides alias and confirms provisioning -> Maya secures partner confirmation and uploads SOW -> Fred uploads signed delegation to the portal -> Giorgio flags invoice & creates holdback memo -> I hold the joint announcement until morning audit. If all green by EOD, we lift hold.

Sophie O: Override applied. Provisioning initiated; resources showing in eu-west. Request ID: rsrc-87321.

marketplace-bot: fulfillment update — resources provisioned (rsrc-87321) in eu-west-1 at 2026-04-01T18:23Z.

Maya S: Partner confirmed delegation accepted. SOW note submitted to partner portal.

Giorgio F: Invoice flagged provisional. Holdback line added: "VAT reconciliation pending - holdback 100% of VAT component." Finance ticket FT-8941.

Fred L: Delegation PDF uploaded to marketplace portal and saved to /legal/marketplace/delegations/2026-ACME-4312.pdf.

Alex P: All boxes checked. Joint announcement paused until tomorrow 09:00 CET for overnight audit. If nothing unexpected, go/no-go call in the morning. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
